commands.name: check
commands.description: Validate an OKF bundle directory for structural and content issues.

options.name: --json
options.description: Output validation issues as JSON instead of human-readable text. [Default: false]

commands.name: graph
commands.description: Generate an OKF graph file for the bundle.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output path for the generated graph file. [Default: okf.json, or okf.js with --js]

options.name: --body
options.description: Include body content in the graph. [Default: false]

options.name: --js
options.description: Emit a plain JS script that sets window.data (loadable via <script src> on file:// too). [Default: false]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Only render errors and warnings. [Default: false]

options.name: --json
options.description: Output validation issues as JSON instead of human-readable text. [Default: false]

options.name: --properties
options.description: Properties in format Key=Value. Can be repeated.

commands.name: view
commands.description:
Generate an Obsidian-style single-file reader (index.html) plus a full body+nav okf.json.
Always builds with concept bodies and the index-driven nav tree.
Default writes both files into the bundle root (overwrites an existing compact okf.json).

options.name: --out
options.description: Output directory, or path to index.html / okf.json (see design). Extension-less paths are directories. [Default: bundle root] [Default: null]

options.name: --name
options.description: Display name in the HTML title. [Default: directory name] [Default: null]

options.name: --open
options.description: Open the generated index.html in the default browser. [Default: false]
